messages:
Amanda: Heads-up — we need to cut release/1.17 tomorrow 17:00 PT. Please confirm backport exceptions and owners. Quick checklist below.

Devon: Can we push the cutoff to 18:00? I have one small cleanup PR queued.

Amanda: Prefer 17:00 to keep rollout window. If it's small and tests pass, file a cherry-pick request with the `critical` label and @Riley will triage.

Riley: I can triage after lunch. Rule of thumb: only bugfix + security + release-blocking infra fixes. No new features, no perf experiments. Docs and nonblocking refactors wait for next minor.

Lia: I'm on changelog assembly. Add bullets to `build/changelog/1.17.md` by EOD. Use format: `- <subsystem>: short description (#PR)` — keeps things simple for release notes.

Mike: Who runs the branch create? I can run the script but need confirmation of base commit.

Amanda: Base will be `origin/main` at commit `a1b2c3d` (latest after merge window). Run: `scripts/create-release-branch --base a1b2c3d --name release/1.17`.

release-bot: deploy-bot: queued job: release-branch-create requested by @Amanda — status: pending

Devon: OK I'll finish my cleanup and open a PR within 30m, pinging @Riley for backport label if needed.

Riley: Please add `backport/1.17` label on PRs you want considered and include a PR comment with: `Backport request: reason, risk, test plan`. I'll respond accept/reject there.

Amanda: If a backport looks risky, call it out in the PR. @Mike: don't auto-include risky PRs in cherry-pick runs without explicit approval.

Mike: Got it. After branch create I'll run: `git checkout -b release/1.17 origin/release/1.17 && ./scripts/prepare-release` then push and trigger the smoke job.

Lia: Changelog note — please include PR numbers and one-line descriptions. I'll aggregate and post the candidate changelog for review at 16:30 PT.

Devon: :thumbsup:

Riley: Quick Q — do we allow hotfixes to land on main after branch cut? That tends to cause divergence.

Amanda: Only emergency hotfixes with two approvals + passing full e2e. Otherwise they go into next minor. Documented exception process: ping #eng-oncall + two reviewers.

release-bot: deploy-bot: release branch 'release/1.17' created by @Mike at 2612348010 — link: https://git.internal/repo/branches/release/1.17

Mike: Branch created and pushed. Kicked off `ci/release-smoke/1.17` (smoke job id: smoke-2612348011).

Amanda: Thanks all. If you have backport PRs, tag them now. I'll close this thread after changelog confirmed and smoke job is green.
